subject.title: fix: queued voice replies are lost when the delivery queue retries them

question: Should outbound delivery adopt this queue-owned media spool with live-only `best_effort` fallback, fail-closed `required` behavior, and conservative unbounded retention for unverifiable owners?
rationale: The implementation appears technically coherent, but the fallback behavior, persistent sensitive-media boundary, and disk-retention policy are product and operational choices that cannot be inferred solely from tests.

options.title: Approve guarded spool
options.body: Accept the current queue-ownership model after exact-head checks and explicit security and outbound-owner review of access and retention semantics.

options.title: Require bounded operations
options.body: Keep the ownership model but require storage observability or a separately approved bounded-retention policy before merge.

options.title: Pause durable media replay
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a different durability contract, accepting that queued temporary voice media remains unreplayable meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded spool
recommendation.body: Accept the current queue-ownership model after exact-head checks and explicit security and outbound-owner review of access and retention semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged delivery-queue and media-policy work makes this person the closest available history-based owner for the contract decision.
